text: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion: it cannot be shaken, it stands forever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people, both now and forevermore.

versions.text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people, from now to eternity.
versions.explanation: "From now to eternity" is an unusual English collocation that can distract a listener. "Both now and forevermore" renders מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם accurately and closes the verse with a smoother cadence for oral reading.

text: The scepter of wickedness will not rest on the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not stretch out their hands to do wrong.
Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.
But those who turn aside to their crooked ways—the LORD will lead them away with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel!

versions.text: But those who turn aside to crooked ways—the LORD will lead them away with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew has the possessive suffix on עַקַלְקַלּוֹתָם ("their crooked ways"), which the current rendering drops; adding it is more accurate. The closing blessing also reads more naturally as an exclamation when spoken aloud.
